job.title: Business Analyst
job.description:
Business Analyst - 3 Month Contract
 
We are currently seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support our client for a 3-month contract on Wave 1 of a Regulatory Assessment Transformation Program, assisting in establishing an AI-assisted regulatory assessment capability.
About the Role
 
The Business Analyst will work with business and project stakeholders to define business problems, understand current and future-state processes, elicit and document requirements, assess options and support delivery outcomes.
 
Key activities will include:
  • Documenting business requirements and assessment criteria in a controlled Requirements Register.
  • Analysing and mapping the BMP assessment process, including evidence requirements, decision points and governance controls.
  • Working with assessors, Legal, leadership and other stakeholders to support engagement and prototype design.
  • Supporting testing and validation activities.
  • Developing the assessment guide and approved Copilot prompt library.
  • Supporting scope clarification, risks, dependencies, decisions and delivery activities.
  • Developing and maintaining BA artefacts including requirements, process maps, user stories, acceptance criteria and decision records.
About You
 
To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • Demonstrated experience working as a Business Analyst across projects.
  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, process analysis, process mapping and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience developing clear and fit-for-purpose business analysis documentation.
  • Strong ability to work with Project Managers, business owners, SMEs, technology teams, vendors and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder influencing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and operate effectively in an ambiguous and evolving environment.
  • Experience supporting project planning, risks, dependencies and delivery outcomes.
  • A degree in Business, IT, Business Analysis, Project Management or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Desirable: Experience working within a government, regulatory or public sector environment, as well as Business Analysis certification or training such as IIBA, CBAP, Agile Business Analysis or BABOK-aligned training.

job.title: Technical Writer
job.description:
Our electrical and communications services industry client is looking for Technical writer in Melbourne on FTC basis.

Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities
  • Write and format inspection and test plans to a single agreed SME standard.
  • Build the master ITP library so that inspection points, evidence requirements and acceptance criteria are consistent across projects.
  • Interview site teams to capture how tasks are actually performed.
  • Convert proven work methods into standard operating procedures with named owners, revision control and review dates.
  • Source acceptance criteria from project specifications, drawings and Australian Standards, and quote the values within the document.
  • Tailor generic ITPs and SOPs to contract requirements and project risks ahead of mobilisation.
  • Apply document numbering, revision control and approval workflow so that every document is traceable.
  • Maintain the document register and keep superseded versions clearly marked.
  • Incorporate review comments from the Quality Manager, engineering and site supervision.
  • Update ITPs and SOPs when non-conformances and lessons learned identify a gap.
  • Prepare supporting material such as visual work guides and pre-start aids where they improve uptake on site.
Key Capabilities / Experience
Essential
  • Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to write plainly for a site audience and keep instructions short enough to be used on the tools.
  • Experience producing controlled documents under revision and approval control.
  • Confidence interviewing tradespeople and supervisors to draw out how work is really done, and the judgement to push past vague answers.
  • Advanced Microsoft Word: templates, styles, numbering, tables and cross-references applied consistently across a large document set.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for maintaining registers and trackers.
  • Organised and self-directed, able to run a document programme to agreed deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Attention to detail, particularly with numeric acceptance criteria, hold and witness points, and cross-references between documents.
Desirable
  • Experience writing inspection and test plans, checklists or quality forms in a construction, manufacturing or utilities setting.
  • Familiarity with electrical installation work and the terminology used on site.
  • Ability to produce simple visual aids such as annotated photographs, sketches and single-page field guides.
  • Ability to read drawings, specifications and Australian Standards and pull firm requirements out of them, including numeric acceptance criteria
Qualifications / Certifications
Required
  • Demonstrated experience in technical writing, documentation or procedure development.
  • Construction Industry General Safety Induction (White Card), or willingness to obtain one before attending site.
  • Current Australian driver’s licence, with the ability to travel between project sites.
If that suits please apply through this ad.

  • Customer Service

job.title: Change Manager

This role will be the sole change resource, so you will need to be highly autonomous, hands-on and comfortable working in an environment where the solution, impacts and requirements are still evolving.

job.title: Training Consultant - WalkMe
job.description:
Training Consultant - WalkMe
 
We are seeking a hands-on Digital Adoption & Learning Specialist / Training Consultant to join the program on an initial six-month contract, with the possibility of extension.
 
The primary focus of the role will be supporting the implementation of WalkMe across the Hyphen suite. You will work closely with Training, Change, Business Readiness and L&D teams to quickly understand new systems and business processes and translate these into effective in-system guidance and learning support.

We are looking for someone with a strong learning background who can also support broader training activities when required, including developing learning materials and facilitating training.

Ideally, you will have previous hands-on WalkMe experience and have personally built and configured WalkMe content, rather than only managing a WalkMe implementation or vendor relationship. 
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Build and configure digital adoption content, ideally using WalkMe
  • Design and develop learning materials for new technology and business processes
  • Facilitate end-user training, demonstrations, workshops and/or train-the-trainer sessions
  • Quickly understand new technology, business processes and user journeys
  • Determine the most appropriate learning intervention, including what should be supported through WalkMe, formal training, learning materials or other performance support
  • Develop user guides, quick-reference guides, digital learning content and facilitator materials
  • Work alongside Training/L&D, Change and business teams within a transformation or technology implementation
  • Engage effectively with business SMEs and technology teams
  • Independently build, test, troubleshoot and refine WalkMe content
  • Work directly with WalkMe and leverage their expertise and support where required
  • Document the solution, share knowledge and support the eventual transition to BAU ownership
About You
  • Has hands-on experience with digital adoption platforms, ideally WalkMe
  • Understands how digital adoption platforms work
  • Can troubleshoot issues when required
  • Learns new technology quickly
  • Understands how people learn and adopt new ways of working
  • Can translate complex processes into simple, practical and user-friendly guidance
  • Has strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Can work independently while collaborating effectively with business and technology teams

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
We are partnering with a rapidly growing organistion, delivering some of Australia’s largest data centre projects. With a significant pipeline of projects across Australia, this is a unique opportunity to join a business at a pivotal stage of growth and help shape its project delivery capability for the future.

We are seeking an experienced Construction Project Managers to partner closely with highly skilled Electrical Leads across major project sites. This role will focus on driving programme delivery, governance, reporting, scheduling, compliance, and stakeholder coordination across complex construction environments.

This is more than a traditional project management role — it is an opportunity to help uplift delivery maturity, introduce structured project management practices, and build scalable delivery capability within a fast-growing organisation.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead project governance, planning, reporting, scheduling, and delivery coordination across major data centre construction projects
  • Partner with Electrical / Technical Leads to ensure successful project execution
  • Manage risks, dependencies, compliance requirements, and delivery reporting
  • Drive programme discipline and structured project management methodologies across project teams
  • Coordinate with builders, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders across multiple workstreams
  • Support the uplift of project delivery capability, processes, and reporting standards across the organisation
  • Navigate a hands-on construction culture and build trusted relationships with site-based teams
  • Ensure compliance with both internal delivery standards and builder-mandated processes and systems
About You:
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale construction or infrastructure projects, ideally within data centres, mission-critical environments, or complex industrial builds
  • Strong foundational project management capability across governance, scheduling, reporting, risk, and stakeholder management
  • Experience working within fast-paced construction delivery environments
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively across both corporate and site-based stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating in practical, delivery-focused environments with strong trade and construction cultures
  • Experience using Primavera P6, MS Project, Aconex, or similar construction delivery tools highly regarded
  • Ability to bring structure, process, and delivery discipline while maintaining strong working relationships across teams

What's on offer?
  • $180k - $200k + Super
  • Permanent Employment
  • Predominantly wokring on-site (4-5 days p/w)
  • Inner-West suburbs of Melbourne location

job.title: Infra Solutions Architect
job.description:
Infrastructure Solution Architect
 
We are currently supporting our client in the search for an experienced Solution Architect to join their team.

You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders, project teams, vendors and the Enterprise Architecture function to develop effective, secure and scalable solutions across infrastructure, applications, information and technology domains.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and deliver end-to-end solution architectures aligned with business requirements and strategic technology roadmaps.
  • Work with business stakeholders, Project Managers and Business Analysts to understand project objectives, requirements and constraints.
  • Evaluate and recommend technology solutions, considering cost, risk, security, scalability, performance and total cost of ownership.
  • Design secure server, network and Azure cloud solutions.
  • Facilitate architecture workshops and communicate technical solutions clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain current-state and future-state architecture documentation.
  • Contribute to architecture standards, principles, patterns, reference architectures and technology roadmaps.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring and thought leadership to project teams.
  • Conduct design reviews and ensure solutions align with agreed architecture standards and requirements.
  • Consider operational requirements including resilience, high availability, monitoring, maintainability and performance.
  • Work with vendors and external consultants to assess and develop appropriate technology solutions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement across IT architecture, delivery and operational practices.
About You
  • 5+ years' experience designing and developing complex IT infrastructure solutions.
  • Proven experience taking accountability for solution architecture and technical outcomes.
  • Strong experience designing secure server, network and Azure cloud solutions.
  • Experience documenting solution architectures across business, application, information and technology domains.
  • Experience evaluating and selecting technology solutions and components.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to facilitate workshops and engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience working across a variety of software development methodologies.
Desirable
  • Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks and notations such as TOGAF or ArchiMate.
  • Relevant architecture or cloud certifications.
 
What You'll Bring
 
You will be a collaborative and consultative technology professional who can operate across both business and technical environments. You will be comfortable acting as a trusted advisor, translating business requirements into practical technology solutions and contributing to the organization's broader technology strategy.

job.title: Programmer / Scheduler - Primavera P6
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Primavera P6 Programmer / Scheduler to join a central PMO and provide scheduling support across a portfolio of complex projects.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across multiple projects and contractors, with responsibility for developing robust, resource-loaded programmes and providing accurate reporting to support project delivery and commercial outcomes.

You will be responsible for:
  • Developing, updating and maintaining Primavera P6 programmes across multiple concurrent projects
  • Building and managing resource-loaded schedules, ensuring resource allocation and forecasting remain accurate
  • Establishing and maintaining project structures including EPS, OBS, WBS and activity coding
  • Producing programme reporting and Power BI dashboards using P6 data to provide visibility of progress, productivity and performance
  • Managing baselines, progress updates and rolling lookahead programmes
  • Monitoring critical paths, programme logic, milestones and schedule performance
  • Ensuring programmes are maintained to a standard that provides clear and defensible evidence for EOT and variation claims
  • Working closely with Project Managers, Program Managers, commercial teams and contractors to align programmes with project and contractual requirements
  • Supporting consistent scheduling processes, coding standards and governance across the portfolio
  • Managing P6/XER file exchanges with head contractors and subcontractors
About You:
You will have 5+ years' hands-on Primavera P6 experience, with a strong background in resource-loaded programming and schedule management.

You'll ideally bring:
  • Strong Primavera P6 capability, including resource loading and resource levelling
  • Experience working across construction, infrastructure or engineering projects
  • A solid understanding of critical path methodology, programme logic and schedule analysis
  • Experience developing Power BI reporting from P6 data
  • Experience working with multiple projects, contractors and stakeholders simultaneously
  • An understanding of programme requirements relating to EOTs, variations and commercial claims
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with project teams, contractors and senior stakeholders

What's on offer?
  • $160k - $170k + Super
  • Permanent employment
  • Onsite/ in office 4+ days p/w
  • Inner-West suburbs of Melbourne location

  • Strong understanding of resource loading and resource allocation
  • Experience working across construction, infrastructure or engineering environments

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to train and mentor existing schedulers

What's on offer?
